title: Intent Classification
description: Classify user intent and extract semantic entities (crop, region, tags, followup) for adaptive retrieval routing. All extraction is LLM-decided; no keyword fallbacks.

needs_tool_call.description: Whether weather/mandi/scheme MCP tools are needed

crop_name.description: Crop the farmer is asking about, lowercase English (e.g. 'rice', 'wheat', 'cotton', 'tomato'). Empty string if not mentioned and not inferable.

crop_stage.description: Growth stage if mentioned or clearly implied (e.g. 'seedling', 'tillering', 'flowering', 'grain_filling', 'harvest'). Empty string if unknown.

state_or_region.description: Indian state, district, or region the farmer references (e.g. 'Punjab', 'Vidarbha', 'West Bengal'). Empty string if not mentioned.

topic_tags.description: Semantic tags describing the agronomic topic. Pick from: fungal_disease, bacterial_disease, viral_disease, pest, insect, nutrient_deficiency, water_management, weather_damage, soil_health, weed, harvest, post_harvest, market, scheme, credit, insurance, general. 0-4 tags.

is_followup.description: True if this message is a follow-up to a previous advisory (e.g. asks 'why', 'kitna', refers to 'it', or builds on prior context). False if the message stands alone.
